Hi Elena — great questions. I put together a short note and attached a simple worksheet showing a Starter vs Dedicated+Optimize bundle so procurement can see the math. High-level answers below, then I list the assumptions we used in the worksheet.

1) Upgrade path & proration
- You can start on Hosted API (pay-as-you-go) and move to Dedicated with a 30-day notice. If you upgrade mid-month we pro-rate the Dedicated charge so you only pay for the remainder of the billing period at the committed rate. There is a one-time onboarding & model pinning fee for Dedicated.

2) Embeddings
- Embeddings are metered separately (per-embedding unit) but we offer a bundled per-token/embedding rate when you take Dedicated + Optimize for a 12-month commit.

3) Bundle discounts
- Typical bundle: Dedicated (committed tokens/hr) + Redwood Optimize (cost/latency tuning) + 30-day extended observability. For a 12-month commit we can offer a 12–18% list discount depending on committed vCPUs/GPU profile. For a multi-year or larger commit we can extend up to ~25% and include a dedicated TAM.

Key worksheet assumptions (attached): target qps, avg tokens per response, embedding units/month, desired SLA 99.9%. I also included two example rows showing a 3-month ramp scenario.

If it's helpful I'd like to loop in Aditya (solutions) to confirm our assumptions about embedding throughput and whether you need KV-cache sizing for the first phase.

Next steps: If procurement prefers, I can translate the worksheet into a short quote with line-item pricing and proration rules.

Neha — quick technical read:

- With the worksheet assumptions (avg resp 120 tokens, 250 qps, embeddings 120k/month) we can run the initial phase on a 2xA10 pool with prefix caching enabled. That gives headroom for bursts and keeps latency under 120ms p95 for generation and ~40ms p95 for embeddings.
- KV-cache sizing: recommend enabling prefix cache (128GB) and a cache hit target of 18–22% to reduce token cost. If FinWise expects higher cache reuse, we'll need to size for 256GB and that shifts the recommended GPU nodes.
- On pricing: 12% bundle discount for a 12-month commit is reasonable and within Neha's quota for ACV up to $250k. Anything above that should go to Rishi for approval.

Summary: technically viable on single pool for initial runway; 12% is okay for your sell motion if ACV <= $250k.

—Aditya
